answer.summary: A large, orderly market-town city on level ground: city hall and grand market hall at the centre, townhouses, apartment blocks, corner shops and a tavern around them, and smithy, granary and gatehouse at the edge. The grid of numbered avenues is written as a grid layout, which Architect can't build yet, so it waits until that arrives; the avenue signs are left to the style.
